name: CHI St. Alexius Health Teen Volunteers (Bismarck)
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the hospital. They do not provide hands-on patient care.
who_can_apply: Teens must be 14 years old. The page says you will be asked to show proof of age.
duration: Set hours not listed. Teen shifts are available after school, and weekend shifts vary by location.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program page.
how_to_apply: Get the application on the volunteer page. It is in the Bismarck section. The Volunteer Coordinator is Tanya Olheiser. The phone number is (701) 530-7159. The email is tanya.olheiser@commonspirit.org.
notes: The page does not list the service areas, shots or background checks for teens. Ask the coordinator.
